scopes.label: Own
scopes.description: Items the person created, authored, or that are about them.

scopes.label: Assigned
scopes.description: Items the person is attached to: project member, task assignee, assigned client, thread participant.

scopes.label: Project
scopes.description: Items inside projects the person is a member of.

scopes.label: Client (brand)
scopes.description: Client portal users: their own brand's items (and allowed projects).

permissions.label: View agency
permissions.description: View the agency profile and branding.

permissions.label: Update agency
permissions.description: Change agency profile, branding and theme.

permissions.label: View audit log
permissions.description: View the security and audit log.

permissions.label: View storage
permissions.description: View server storage status (platform agency only).

permissions.label: Archive storage
permissions.description: Archive and delete old media (platform agency only).

permissions.label: View members
permissions.description: View team members and their profiles.

permissions.label: Edit compensation
permissions.description: Change salaries and hourly rates (never your own).

permissions.label: Reset passwords
permissions.description: Email a password reset link to a member.

permissions.label: Sign members out
permissions.description: End all sessions of a member.

permissions.label: Assign roles
permissions.description: Assign and remove roles on members.

permissions.label: Manage member exceptions
permissions.description: Add per-member permission grants and denies.

permissions.label: Edit roles
permissions.description: Edit custom roles and editable system roles.

permissions.label: Invite client users
permissions.description: Invite people to the client portal.

permissions.label: Edit client users
permissions.description: Change client user details, role and project access.

permissions.label: Disable client users
permissions.description: Disable or delete client portal accounts.

permissions.label: Reset client passwords
permissions.description: Email a reset link to a client user.

permissions.label: View client financials
permissions.description: View billing details, outstanding amounts and invoice counts.

permissions.label: View client activity
permissions.description: View the cross-module activity feed of a client.

permissions.label: Manage client team
permissions.description: Set the account owner and assigned team.

permissions.label: Manage client portal
permissions.description: Create share links and change portal settings.

permissions.label: Manage contacts
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete client contacts.

permissions.label: Edit posts
permissions.description: Edit posts and reservations (edits reset client approval).

permissions.label: Send for approval
permissions.description: Send posts to the client for approval.

permissions.label: Publish posts
permissions.description: Publish now, mark as posted and control auto-publishing.

permissions.label: Archive month
permissions.description: Run the month-end archive sweep for posts.

permissions.label: Manage social accounts
permissions.description: Connect or disconnect accounts and change auto-publish.

permissions.label: Generate content
permissions.description: Generate captions, ideas, month plans and repurposed content.

permissions.label: Use AI assistant
permissions.description: Chat assistant and document generation (limited to data you can view).

permissions.label: AI task breakdown
permissions.description: Generate tasks and milestones with AI (also needs task permissions).

permissions.label: Delete projects
permissions.description: Delete projects and everything in them.

permissions.label: View project team
permissions.description: See the project team in the client portal.

permissions.label: Manage labels
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete project task labels.

permissions.label: View tasks
permissions.description: View tasks, subtasks, dependencies and history.

permissions.label: Edit tasks
permissions.description: Edit task fields, status, labels and dependencies.

permissions.label: Archive month
permissions.description: Run the month-end archive sweep for tasks.

permissions.label: Track time
permissions.description: Start and stop your own timers.

permissions.label: Check in/out
permissions.description: Check in and out, see your own day.

permissions.label: Who's in
permissions.description: See who is in right now.

permissions.label: Attendance reports
permissions.description: Team summaries and reports, including utilization.

permissions.label: Mark attendance
permissions.description: Mark or override someone else's attendance.

permissions.label: Attendance policy
permissions.description: Office hours, geofence and network policy.

permissions.label: Approve leave
permissions.description: Approve or reject leave (never your own).

permissions.label: Cancel leave
permissions.description: Cancel leave requests (own: pending or upcoming only).

permissions.label: Approve regularizations
permissions.description: Approve or reject corrections (never your own).

permissions.label: Approve checkouts
permissions.description: Approve or reject checkouts (never your own).

permissions.label: Read messages
permissions.description: Read threads you take part in (organization: moderation).

permissions.label: Delete messages
permissions.description: Delete messages (assigned: anyone's message in your threads).

permissions.label: Edit threads
permissions.description: Rename threads and change their client link.

permissions.label: View hidden documents
permissions.description: View documents hidden from the team.

permissions.label: Share with client

permissions.label: Publish sheets
permissions.description: Publish sheet rows into projects, posts and tasks (needs those permissions too).

permissions.label: Assign leads
permissions.description: Change the owner of a lead.

permissions.label: Convert leads
permissions.description: Convert a lead into a client.

permissions.label: Edit proposals
permissions.description: Edit proposals up to conversion (accepted ones warn first).

permissions.label: Delete proposals
permissions.description: Delete proposals that have not become an agreement.

permissions.label: Convert proposals
permissions.description: Convert an accepted proposal into an agreement.

permissions.label: Respond to proposals
permissions.description: Accept or reject proposals as the client.

permissions.label: Edit invoices
permissions.description: Edit unpaid invoices, including bank details.

permissions.label: Change invoice status
permissions.description: Mark invoices sent, paid or cancelled.

permissions.label: Approve posts
permissions.description: Approve posts or request changes as the client.

templates.name: Manager
templates.description: Runs delivery: clients, projects, content, attendance approvals and messages. No finance, business or agency settings.

templates.name: Employee
templates.description: Does the work: own and assigned tasks, time tracking, content, documents, attendance.

templates.name: Content Manager
templates.description: Content calendars, approvals, publishing and social accounts for all clients.

templates.name: HR Manager
templates.description: Team profiles, attendance, leave and approvals.

templates.name: Viewer
templates.description: Read-only access to clients, projects, content and documents.
